mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a pleasant 78 degrees with clear skies at Verona City Hall. We are currently in a first quarter moon phase, and keep your eyes peeled tonight at 9:33 PM as the space station streaks from the northwest over Verona High School toward Fitchburg, appearing halfway up the sky.

In city news, the VHAT cable channel provides full access to local government meetings. Also, please review the city codes regarding vehicle storage, which require vehicles to be kept on approved surfaces and at least five feet from property lines.

This week is packed with community fun, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company on July 21. On July 22, enjoy the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, followed by more trivia options and pizza specials throughout the evening.
Looking at the weekly police report, on July 15, officers responded to a residence on Prairie Oaks Drive where a man was arrested for felony bail jumping.
You can enjoy the decadent Chocolate Caramel Twist today at the Verona Culver's. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
